description: This Java source file defines the StatusFragment class, which is part of the com.example.android.apprestrictionenforcer package. It provides a user interface for managing the installed app's status (uninstall, hide, or enable) within an Android profile, including UI updates and interaction handling.

classes.name: StatusFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that manages the UI for enabling or unhiding an app within an Android device profile, handling user interactions and UI updates related to app status.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and sets click listeners.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the fragment to the activity and initializes the listener.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Detaches the fragment from the activity and clears the listener reference.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates the UI when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events, specifically the 'unhide' button.

methods.name: updateUi
methods.description: Checks the app's installation and hidden status, updating UI accordingly.
